A straight chain of one-nested-table-per-cell tables renders as pipe tables, not a broken layout list

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td><table><tr><td><table><tr><td>leaf</td></tr></table></td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
